$comment: The touch-to-mouse tuning both touchscreen clients share, replayed by the Apple TouchVectorTests (TouchTuning) and the Android TouchVectorTest (TouchTuning, pointerAccel). `tuning` holds the values that must match: times in milliseconds, angles in degrees, `keyboard_swipe_fraction` of the view height, `dial_slop_in_tap_slops` as the dial's slop over the tap slop. Distances that gate a tap are not here: Android measures them in pixels and Apple in points. `accel` is the pointer gain for a finger speed in physical pixels per millisecond: 1 up to the floor, rising by `accel_gain` per px/ms, capped at `accel_max` (compared within 1e-4).
